profiles.notes: TCU and IRDP 2026/27 requirements. School-leaving qualifications and applications.

requirements.label: Tanzanian A levels · cohort scale and 4.0 points
requirements.details: The two qualifying principal passes must total at least 4.0. For ACSEE completed before 2014 or from 2016 onwards, each must be E or higher. A, B, C, D, E and S carry 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 and 0.5 points. The 2014 and 2015 cohorts require at least C in each, with A, B+, B, C, D and E worth 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 and 0.5.

source.title: TCU 2026/27 · secondary school guide · PDF pp. 13, 100–104

requirements.label: Recognition of foreign school qualifications
requirements.details: The receiving institution assesses foreign applicants’ pre-university qualifications for ACSEE equivalence. Tanzanian applicants using overseas qualifications must obtain the relevant NECTA or NACTVET equivalence, index number and award verification number and apply through the domestic route.

source.title: TCU 2026/27 · secondary school guide · PDF pp. 11

requirements.label: Applying online · Form IV number and results
requirements.details: Create an account in IRDP’s online application system with the Form IV index number or equivalent number. Select your entry category, enter your personal and academic details and include every Form IV sitting. Choose at least three eligible programmes, review the application and submit it.

source.title: IRDP 2026/27 prospectus · PDF pp. 87

requirements.label: Application and payment timing
requirements.details: No payment is due when submitting the online application. Once selected, students receive bills and pay during registration using a control number from the bursary.

source.title: IRDP 2026/27 prospectus · PDF pp. 87

requirements.label: Usual undergraduate application calendar
requirements.details: IRDP describes June–July as the usual period for application calls and September–October for notifying successful applicants. The academic year usually starts in October or November. Check the current call for the exact closing date.

source.title: IRDP 2026/27 prospectus · PDF pp. 87

requirements.label: First-year registration after an offer
requirements.details: Attend orientation before the academic year and register within two weeks of the first day of orientation. Present proof of payment of at least half of the fee payable directly to the institute. Students must use the names shown on their Form Four academic certificate.

source.title: IRDP 2026/27 prospectus · PDF pp. 87–88

profiles.notes: Institutional guidance does not specify an intake year. School-leaving qualifications and applications.

requirements.label: Information technology · institute’s additional grade guidance
requirements.details: IRDP’s programme page specifies a minimum D for the qualifying principal passes and at least D in both basic mathematics and English at O level. The 2026/27 TCU row gives the accepted principal subjects and the combined 4.0-point standard. Confirm the extra subject grades with IRDP for your intake.

source.title: IRDP · information technology · direct-entry detail

requirements.label: Selection policy · priorities and first choice
requirements.details: IRDP reviews the academic record as a whole and treats the first programme choice as the applicant’s priority. Its published selection rules give in-service candidates first priority and set a target of at least 25% women among those selected who meet the entry requirements.

source.title: IRDP admission regulations, 2023 edition · PDF pp. 13–14

profiles.notes: TCU and IRDP 2026/27 requirements. Diploma, foundation and other qualifications.

requirements.label: Diploma results and school-leaving qualifications
requirements.details: The 2026/27 national diploma route calls for four O-level passes at D or better, NVA Level III with fewer than four O-level passes, or a formally recognised foreign equivalent. For an ordinary diploma at NTA Level 6, the minimum GPA is 3.0. For programmes accepting an FTC, the national benchmark is a C average. The degree-specific listings identify eligible award fields.

source.title: TCU 2026/27 · diploma and equivalent guide · PDF pp. 13

requirements.label: Grade on the qualifying diploma
requirements.details: IRDP’s diploma-entry benchmark for the degree is a B average or GPA of at least 3.0.

source.title: TCU 2026/27 · diploma and equivalent guide · PDF pp. 167–205

requirements.label: Land management · ordinary diploma or foundation certificate
requirements.details: The 2026/27 IRDP prospectus accepts an ordinary diploma with a B average or GPA of at least 3.0, or the Open University of Tanzania foundation certificate at GPA 3.0 or higher.

source.title: IRDP 2026/27 prospectus · PDF pp. 101

requirements.label: Mwanza economics · additional O-level pass

requirements.label: Information technology · technician awards
